name: ProximityPrompt
simple: A ProximityPrompt is the little "Press E to Open" pop-up that appears when your character walks close to something. When the player presses the key (or taps it on mobile, or presses the controller button), its Triggered event fires so your script can open the door, pick up the item, or anything else.
analogy: A ProximityPrompt is like a doorbell with a sign next to it. When you walk up, you see the sign "Ring bell". Press it, and the people inside (your script) hear it and react.
whenToUse: Pick up items or talk to NPCs.
Hold-to-do actions like "Hold E to repair" using `HoldDuration`.
where: Put it inside a BasePart, an Attachment, or a Model (with a PrimaryPart) in Workspace. Listen to Triggered in a Script (server) for things everyone sees. Shown/Hidden events fire on the client for LocalScripts.

terms.trigger: To set something off. A prompt is triggered when the player presses its key.
terms.line of sight: A clear, unblocked straight path for seeing something.
terms.localize / localization: Translating text into the player's language.
terms.UI: User interface: the buttons and pop-ups you see on the screen.
terms.server: Roblox's computer that runs the shared game for everyone.
terms.KeyCode: The name of a keyboard key or controller button, like `Enum.KeyCode.E`.

examples.title: Press E to open a door
examples.place: Script inside the Door Part (with a ProximityPrompt also inside the Door)
examples.code:
local door = script.Parent
local prompt = door:WaitForChild("ProximityPrompt")

prompt.ActionText = "Open"
prompt.ObjectText = "Door"
prompt.MaxActivationDistance = 10 -- must be within 10 studs

prompt.Triggered:Connect(function(player)
	print(player.Name, "opened the door")
	door.Transparency = 0.8
	door.CanCollide = false
	prompt.Enabled = false -- hide the prompt while open

	task.wait(3)

	door.Transparency = 0
	door.CanCollide = true
	prompt.Enabled = true
end)
explain: The prompt shows "Open" and "Door" when a player is within 10 studs.
Triggered gives us the player who pressed E.
The door becomes see-through and walkable for 3 seconds, then closes again. The prompt hides while the door is open.

examples.title: Hold to collect
examples.place: Script inside a Part with a ProximityPrompt
examples.code:
local gem = script.Parent
local prompt = gem:WaitForChild("ProximityPrompt")

prompt.ActionText = "Collect"
prompt.HoldDuration = 2 -- must hold the key for 2 seconds

prompt.Triggered:Connect(function(player)
	print(player.Name, "collected the gem")
	gem:Destroy()
end)
explain: `HoldDuration = 2` makes the player hold the key for 2 seconds; a circle fills up while they hold.
Triggered only fires after the full 2 seconds.

gotchas: The prompt must be inside a part, attachment, or model with a PrimaryPart that is in Workspace, or it will not show up.
Handle Triggered in a server Script if the result should be seen by everyone (like opening a door).
PromptShown and PromptHidden only fire in LocalScripts, because showing a prompt happens on each player's device.

ProximityPrompt.ActionText.simple: The action word shown on the prompt, like "Open", "Talk", or "Pick up". Default is "Interact".
ProximityPrompt.ActionText.example:
local Workspace = game:GetService("Workspace")
local prompt = Workspace:WaitForChild("Door"):WaitForChild("ProximityPrompt")
prompt.ActionText = "Open"

ProximityPrompt.AutoLocalize.simple: If true, ActionText and ObjectText are automatically translated to the player's language using the localization table.
ProximityPrompt.AutoLocalize.example:
local Workspace = game:GetService("Workspace")
local prompt = Workspace:WaitForChild("Door"):WaitForChild("ProximityPrompt")
prompt.AutoLocalize = true

ProximityPrompt.ClickablePrompt.simple: If true, players can also click or tap the prompt pop-up itself to use it. If false, they must press the key (mobile can still tap).
ProximityPrompt.ClickablePrompt.example:
local Workspace = game:GetService("Workspace")
local prompt = Workspace:WaitForChild("Door"):WaitForChild("ProximityPrompt")
prompt.ClickablePrompt = false

ProximityPrompt.Enabled.simple: If false, the prompt is hidden and cannot be used. Handy to turn a prompt off for a while, like after a chest is opened.
ProximityPrompt.Enabled.example:
local Workspace = game:GetService("Workspace")
local prompt = Workspace:WaitForChild("Door"):WaitForChild("ProximityPrompt")
prompt.Enabled = false

ProximityPrompt.Exclusivity.simple: Decides which prompts can show at the same time: only one prompt total, one per key, or always show.
ProximityPrompt.Exclusivity.example:
local Workspace = game:GetService("Workspace")
local prompt = Workspace:WaitForChild("Door"):WaitForChild("ProximityPrompt")
prompt.Exclusivity = Enum.ProximityPromptExclusivity.AlwaysShow

ProximityPrompt.GamepadKeyCode.simple: Which controller button triggers the prompt. Default is ButtonX.
ProximityPrompt.GamepadKeyCode.example:
local Workspace = game:GetService("Workspace")
local prompt = Workspace:WaitForChild("Door"):WaitForChild("ProximityPrompt")
prompt.GamepadKeyCode = Enum.KeyCode.ButtonA

ProximityPrompt.HoldDuration.simple: How many seconds the player must hold the key to trigger. 0 means a quick press is enough.
ProximityPrompt.HoldDuration.example:
local Workspace = game:GetService("Workspace")
local prompt = Workspace:WaitForChild("Door"):WaitForChild("ProximityPrompt")
prompt.HoldDuration = 1.5

ProximityPrompt.KeyboardKeyCode.simple: Which keyboard key triggers the prompt. Default is E.
ProximityPrompt.KeyboardKeyCode.example:
local Workspace = game:GetService("Workspace")
local prompt = Workspace:WaitForChild("Door"):WaitForChild("ProximityPrompt")
prompt.KeyboardKeyCode = Enum.KeyCode.F

ProximityPrompt.MaxActivationDistance.simple: How close, in studs, the player's character must be for the prompt to appear and work.
ProximityPrompt.MaxActivationDistance.example:
local Workspace = game:GetService("Workspace")
local prompt = Workspace:WaitForChild("Door"):WaitForChild("ProximityPrompt")
prompt.MaxActivationDistance = 8

ProximityPrompt.MaxIndicatorDistance.simple: If above 0, a small hint marker shows when the player is farther than MaxActivationDistance but closer than this, so they know something is nearby. Default 0 turns the hint off.
ProximityPrompt.MaxIndicatorDistance.example:
local Workspace = game:GetService("Workspace")
local prompt = Workspace:WaitForChild("Door"):WaitForChild("ProximityPrompt")
prompt.MaxActivationDistance = 10
prompt.MaxIndicatorDistance = 40 -- hint from 10 to 40 studs away

ProximityPrompt.ObjectText.simple: Optional name of the thing, shown above the action, like "Treasure Chest".
ProximityPrompt.ObjectText.example:
local Workspace = game:GetService("Workspace")
local prompt = Workspace:WaitForChild("Door"):WaitForChild("ProximityPrompt")
prompt.ObjectText = "Treasure Chest"

ProximityPrompt.RequiresLineOfSight.simple: If true, the prompt hides when something blocks the view between the player's camera and the object, like a wall.
ProximityPrompt.RequiresLineOfSight.example:
local Workspace = game:GetService("Workspace")
local prompt = Workspace:WaitForChild("Door"):WaitForChild("ProximityPrompt")
prompt.RequiresLineOfSight = false -- show even through walls

ProximityPrompt.RootLocalizationTable.simple: Which LocalizationTable to use when translating this prompt's text.
ProximityPrompt.RootLocalizationTable.example:
local LocalizationService = game:GetService("LocalizationService")
local Workspace = game:GetService("Workspace")
local prompt = Workspace:WaitForChild("Door"):WaitForChild("ProximityPrompt")
prompt.RootLocalizationTable = LocalizationService:FindFirstChild("MyTable")

ProximityPrompt.Style.simple: Default uses Roblox's built-in pop-up look. Custom shows nothing, so you can draw your own pop-up in a LocalScript using PromptShown and PromptHidden.
ProximityPrompt.Style.example:
local Workspace = game:GetService("Workspace")
local prompt = Workspace:WaitForChild("Door"):WaitForChild("ProximityPrompt")
prompt.Style = Enum.ProximityPromptStyle.Custom

ProximityPrompt.UIOffset.simple: Shifts the pop-up on the screen by this many pixels (X right, Y down), so it does not cover something.
ProximityPrompt.UIOffset.example:
local Workspace = game:GetService("Workspace")
local prompt = Workspace:WaitForChild("Door"):WaitForChild("ProximityPrompt")
prompt.UIOffset = Vector2.new(0, -50) -- 50 pixels higher

ProximityPrompt:InputHoldBegin.simple: For custom prompt buttons: tells the prompt the player started pressing, just as if they pressed the key.
ProximityPrompt:InputHoldBegin.example:
-- LocalScript: a custom on-screen button starts the hold
local Workspace = game:GetService("Workspace")
local prompt = Workspace:WaitForChild("Door"):WaitForChild("ProximityPrompt")
prompt:InputHoldBegin()
task.wait(prompt.HoldDuration)
prompt:InputHoldEnd()

ProximityPrompt:InputHoldEnd.simple: For custom prompt buttons: tells the prompt the player let go.
ProximityPrompt:InputHoldEnd.example:
-- LocalScript
local Workspace = game:GetService("Workspace")
local prompt = Workspace:WaitForChild("Door"):WaitForChild("ProximityPrompt")
prompt:InputHoldEnd()

ProximityPrompt.IndicatorHidden.simple: Fires on the player's device when the small hint marker disappears (they walked away, or got close enough for the real prompt).
ProximityPrompt.IndicatorHidden.example:
-- LocalScript in StarterPlayerScripts
local Workspace = game:GetService("Workspace")
local prompt = Workspace:WaitForChild("Door"):WaitForChild("ProximityPrompt")
prompt.IndicatorHidden:Connect(function()
	print("Hint hidden")
end)

ProximityPrompt.IndicatorShown.simple: Fires on the player's device when the small hint marker appears because they are getting close.
ProximityPrompt.IndicatorShown.example:
-- LocalScript in StarterPlayerScripts
local Workspace = game:GetService("Workspace")
local prompt = Workspace:WaitForChild("Door"):WaitForChild("ProximityPrompt")
prompt.IndicatorShown:Connect(function()
	print("Something is nearby!")
end)

ProximityPrompt.PromptButtonHoldBegan.simple: Fires when a player starts holding the key on a prompt that has a HoldDuration above 0. Gives you the player.
ProximityPrompt.PromptButtonHoldBegan.example:
local Workspace = game:GetService("Workspace")
local prompt = Workspace:WaitForChild("Door"):WaitForChild("ProximityPrompt")
prompt.PromptButtonHoldBegan:Connect(function(player)
	print(player.Name, "started holding")
end)

ProximityPrompt.PromptButtonHoldEnded.simple: Fires when the player stops holding the key on a hold prompt (whether or not they finished).
ProximityPrompt.PromptButtonHoldEnded.example:
local Workspace = game:GetService("Workspace")
local prompt = Workspace:WaitForChild("Door"):WaitForChild("ProximityPrompt")
prompt.PromptButtonHoldEnded:Connect(function(player)
	print(player.Name, "let go")
end)

ProximityPrompt.PromptHidden.simple: Fires in LocalScripts when the prompt disappears from the player's screen.
ProximityPrompt.PromptHidden.example:
-- LocalScript in StarterPlayerScripts
local Workspace = game:GetService("Workspace")
local prompt = Workspace:WaitForChild("Door"):WaitForChild("ProximityPrompt")
prompt.PromptHidden:Connect(function()
	print("Prompt hidden")
end)

ProximityPrompt.PromptShown.simple: Fires in LocalScripts when the prompt appears on the player's screen. It tells you the kind of input they are using (keyboard, touch, or gamepad).
ProximityPrompt.PromptShown.example:
-- LocalScript in StarterPlayerScripts
local Workspace = game:GetService("Workspace")
local prompt = Workspace:WaitForChild("Door"):WaitForChild("ProximityPrompt")
prompt.PromptShown:Connect(function(inputType)
	print("Prompt shown for", inputType)
end)

ProximityPrompt.Triggered.simple: The main event: fires when the player presses the key (or finishes holding it). Gives you the player who did it.
ProximityPrompt.Triggered.example:
local Workspace = game:GetService("Workspace")
local prompt = Workspace:WaitForChild("Door"):WaitForChild("ProximityPrompt")
prompt.Triggered:Connect(function(player)
	print(player.Name, "used the prompt")
end)

ProximityPrompt.TriggerEnded.simple: Fires when the player lets go of the key after triggering. Useful for actions that last while held, like healing a friend.
ProximityPrompt.TriggerEnded.example:
local Workspace = game:GetService("Workspace")
local prompt = Workspace:WaitForChild("Door"):WaitForChild("ProximityPrompt")
prompt.TriggerEnded:Connect(function(player)
	print(player.Name, "stopped")
end)
